description: Generate a publishable llms.txt for a website from the pages found on it (llmstxt.org format), or validate the llms.txt it already has. Returns the file as text to save at the site root as /llms.txt. Use it when someone asks to create, fix or check llms.txt, or to make a site easier for AI engines to read. Nothing is invented: only pages that exist are listed, and the result says how many pages were read.

domain.description: The website to check, like acme.com. A full URL is accepted and reduced to its domain.
domain.title: Domain

validate_existing.description: True to check the llms.txt the site already serves instead of writing a new one.
validate_existing.title: Validate Existing

name: generate_llms_txt
